text:
Life is a dream,
but a fevered dream lasting only an instant;
when one wakes from it,
one sees that all is vanity and smoke...

If only it were a dream
very long and very deep,
a dream that lasted until death!
I would dream of my love and yours.

translation.title: Rhyme XC: Life Is a Dream
